name: Tuggowar.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Tuggowar is a free card game. Tuggowar is the most epic 1v1 deck-building game. This strategy game has a simple and innovative concept. Each match has a unique set of cards to choose from. Build an epic combo deck or attack, disrupt, and counter the Enemy. Incredible vector art with tons of cool basic and unlockable card. This is the perfect game for people who love 1v1 and strategy games and want their creativity, skill, and strategy to shine without being bullied or beaten by random decks. The cool thing about this game is that every player has the same deck and the same access to the same cards. This is a great place to start if you've never played a deckbuilder. Great campaign for first-timers and veterans alike.
